set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit 0 family inet address 10.100.0.11/2.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set routing-options static route 10.1.3..explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask.

next-hop 10.100.0.10.explanation: Configures the static route, specifies the destination network and the next jump address.

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: Next jump address, the package forwards to the next stop of the destination network.
